jobs.occupation: Radar Simulation Specialist (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to provide high-fidelity training simulation, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Radar Simulation Specialist (d/f/m)

You will join a team of experienced engineers and subject matter experts to jointly define, implement and integrate complex simulation sub-systems in the domain of sensors and weapons. Our engineers are closely collaborating with other departments and external suppliers in order to provide solutions for high-fidelity trainings systems, with current focus on the Eurofighter pilot training simulation system PSTS.

You will serve as Technical Lead to ensure the provision of tailored simulation solutions for various radar systems, ranging from versatile, generic model to high-fidelity replicas of actual systems, such as the current Eurofighter MSCAN Radar, as well as future systems such as the Eurofighter ESCAN Radar. Based on your deep technical understanding of actual systems and your knowledge of electronic warfare, you will play a key role in the definition and development of optimal solutions to match simulation and/or training needs while respecting technical limitations of distributed real-time systems. As such, you are closely cooperating with various engineering teams, Chief Engineering and Operational Factors, and will act for Radar-related topics as point of contract for alignments and discussions with the Customer and external suppliers.

Major Role & Responsibilities

- Technical Lead to ensure the provision of tailored Radar simulation solutions
- Ensuring the technical expertise regarding current and future radar systems, such as Eurofighter MSCAN and ESCAN Radar
- Performance of Systems Engineering activities to ensure the viable technical radar solutions meeting the requirements and needs of the overall system.
- Technical coordination of external suppliers an alignment with internal stakeholders, such as Chief Engineering, development teams and Operational Factors
- Support of the integration and testing activities at the simulation devices in close collaboration of other subject matter experts
- Ensuring on-time, cost- and quality-compliant development as well as integration of a consistent and powerful radar simulation across all project phases.
- Technical support in the assessment and selection of suppliers

Specific & Technical Skills / Experience Required

- Expertise regarding - Eurofighter MSCAN Radar
- Eurofighter Training Needs and the current Pilot Synthetic Traning System (PSTS)
- Systems engineering (incl. tools such as DOORS)
- V-model based SW development process
- Extensive Experience in - Eurofighter MSCAN Radar integration and/or flight test
- Eurofighter Training Simulations Solutions (ASTA/PSTS)
- Eurofighter MSCAN Radar integration and/or flight test
- Systems Engineering and V-model based SW development process, including active contribution in integration activities
- IT literate (MS Office applications)

General Skills / Experience Required

- Educated to degree level in computer science or engineering
- Good language skills in English, both written and spoken
- Strong communication skills with an ability to operate in a multi-cultural environment
- Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy while maintaining close, effective collaboration within a multi-disciplinary team.
- Capability to respond to changes in activities and priorities
- Experience in the alignment with and coordination of various stakeholders

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

**Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

Your mission

- Tech Exploration: Evaluate new frameworks and tools, share your findings with the team, and help us stay at the forefront of Big Data technology.

Your skills

- Quality Mindset: You don’t ship without tests. You value efficiency, clean architecture, and pragmatic solutions.

Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
We are seeking an accomplished Scientist to advance our mission of delivering disease-modifying therapies to patients with liver cirrhosis.
As Principal Scientist, you will lead a team of lab scientists and take ownership of identifying and advancing novel therapeutic approaches — from target identification through to candidate selection. A deep understanding of liver physiology and expert knowledge of disease-relevant cellular and tissue models will set you up for success in this role.
Join us and drive innovative drug discovery projects within our Cardio-Renal-Metabolic Diseases Research Department, located at Boehringer Ingelheim's largest R&D site in Biberach an der Riss, Germany. You will work alongside talented colleagues, access cutting-edge technology, and help shape the future of liver disease therapy
Tasks & responsibilities

- Manage an in vitro pharmacology lab and mentor a team of highly skilled lab scientists, fostering a collaborative environment and actively developing the skills of your team members.
- Apply innovative in vitro and ex vivo models that reflect human liver disease conditions to identify promising drug candidates.
- Build the evidence base to translate therapeutic concepts from preclinical models to patients, leveraging experimental models and data science tools.
- Navigate effectively within a matrix-based environment, collaborating across disciplines including Medicinal Chemistry, Biologics Development, Drug Discovery Support functions, Computational Innovation, and Experimental Medicine.
- Enable decision making by communicating complex results efficiently to stakeholders.
- Maintain a strong external network, manage external collaborations, and contribute to advancing the science of liver cirrhosis by publishing papers and presenting at scientific conferences

Requirements

- Doctorate (PhD) in biology, biochemistry, or molecular pharmacology, with expert knowledge in liver physiology specifically the pathophysiology of cirrhosis complications. Knowledge of alcohol-associated liver cirrhosis is a plus.
- Multiple years of drug discovery experience in a pharmaceutical industry setting, with demonstrated expertise spanning target identification through to candidate selection. Proficiency in cell-based methods (primary cells, organotypic cultures) to model liver disease conditions in vitro/ex vivo. Skilled in molecular, cellular and biochemical profiling techniques.
- Proven line-management and leadership skills, including setting and evaluating objectives and advancing the development of team members.
- Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary project team.
- Strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills, combined with agile working, innovative thinking, and a problem-solving mindset.
Fluent written and spoken English; knowledge of German is a plus.

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
At Boehringer Ingelheim, we are committed to transforming patients' lives through breakthrough science and innovative therapeutic modalities. Oligonucleotide therapeutics, including siRNA-based medicines and targeted RNA delivery technologies, represent one of the most exciting frontiers in modern drug discovery.
To strengthen our growing RNA therapeutics capabilities, we are seeking an experienced and visionary scientist to establish and lead an in-house oligonucleotide chemistry platform within Medicinal Chemistry.
In this highly visible role, you will combine scientific leadership with hands-on laboratory expertise. You will establish laboratory capabilities for oligonucleotide synthesis and characterization, support drug discovery programs across multiple therapeutic areas, and help shape Boehringer Ingelheim's long-term strategy and intellectual property position in siRNA therapeutics, conjugate technologies and tissue-targeted delivery approaches. You will drive the future direction of oligonucleotide-based drug discovery at Boehringer-Ingelheim.
Tasks & responsibilities
As Principal Scientist Oligonucleotide Discovery Platform & RNA Therapeutics, you will:

- Establish, operate, lead and continuously advance Boehringer Ingelheim's in-house oligonucleotide synthesis and characterization laboratory within the Medicinal Chemistry Department.
- Serve as scientific lead for oligonucleotide chemistry, RNA modification strategies and conjugate technologies across Discovery Research.
- Design, synthesize, purify and characterize siRNAs, chemically modified oligonucleotides and oligonucleotide conjugates to support portfolio projects.
- Develop innovative chemical solutions enabling improved potency, durability, safety and tissue-specific delivery of RNA therapeutics.
- Drive the identification, evaluation and implementation of novel RNA-targeting technologies and emerging delivery concepts.
- Build deep expertise in extrahepatic delivery strategies and tissue-targeted RNA therapeutics.
- Collaborate closely with biology, DMPK, translational medicine, pharmaceutical sciences and external partners to advance RNA therapeutic programs.
- Contribute to target assessment and modality selection by evaluating the suitability of RNA-based approaches for challenging disease targets.
- Lead interdisciplinary, global oligonucleotide based projects and drive drug discovery programs from ideation to development candidate.
- Identify opportunities for proprietary innovation and develop sustainable intellectual property positions in oligonucleotide chemistry, RNA modification and conjugate design.
- Support the development of differentiated platform technologies and contribute to patent filings.
- Establish external scientific networks and monitor technological developments across academia, biotechnology and pharmaceutical research.
- Present research findings and project updates to internal stakeholders and external collaborators.
- Mentor scientists and contribute to the development of Boehringer Ingelheim's future oligonucleotide strategy.

Requirements

- PhD in organic chemistry, medicinal chemistry, nucleic acid chemistry, biochemistry or a related discipline.
- Industrial or academic experience in oligonucleotide therapeutics and RNA-targeting drug discovery.
- Strong hands-on expertise in solid-phase oligonucleotide synthesis, purification and analytical characterization.
- Deep understanding of siRNA design principles, chemical modification strategies and conjugate technologies.
- Experience with GalNAc-siRNA, extrahepatic delivery technologies or oligonucleotide-targeting ligands is highly desirable.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with enthusiasm for building new scientific capabilities and platforms.
- Experience in leading research projects in an industry setting is an advantage.
- Prior experience in establishing an oligonucleotide laboratory or serving as an oligonucleotide laboratory manager is an advantage; a thorough familiarity with the relevant instrumentation is, as a minimum, expected.
- Team-oriented and collegial attitude with profound communication skills.
- Proficient oral and written communication skills in English as well as willingness to adopt a basic command of the German language.

SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speedEurope's industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories — the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.
A factory that ships in days rather than months is only as fast as what moves in and out of it. Our materials, equipment, and parts cross borders — between European countries, and out to customers in defense, aerospace, and space. Every tariff classification, every export declaration, every forwarder who doesn't deliver is a potential standstill at the end of the line.
Until now, this has been handled across several people. From here on, it belongs to one.
The Roleou are the first person at SAEKI to own import and export end to end. Early on, that means doing it yourself: you run the day-to-day execution, clean up where processes are improvised, and build the structure underneath as you go — customs procedures, export control, service provider landscape, ERP data.
We're growing fast, and this function grows with us. One person becomes a team. Whoever takes this role now decides what logistics at SAEKI looks like in three years — which providers we use, which processes run, which systems we're on, and who operates them. That isn't a promise of a title; it's a realistic path: build the function well, and you lead it.
Based in the greater Munich area, on-site at Factory ONE.

Your Responsibilities
• Import & export execution: You handle national and international shipments end to end — including shipping and customs documentation, tariff classification, and proofs of origin.
• Cross-border movements: You own transport between our Swiss and German sites, as well as to customers and suppliers across Europe and beyond.
• Export control: You build how we assess and document dual-use and export-controlled matters — not an optional topic in our markets.
• Provider management: You select forwarders and logistics service providers, negotiate terms, and keep performance and cost transparent.
• Process building: You turn recurring activities into documented processes — written so they hold up when someone other than you runs them.
• ERP & data: You keep logistics data in the ERP clean, current, and usable, and help shape how the system is set up for logistics.
• Interface role: You work closely with procurement, production, and engineering, and you're the point where delivery dates become commitments.
• Scaling: You recognise when the work outgrows one person, and build the next stage with us — processes, tools, team.

What We're Looking For
• Foundation: A completed commercial apprenticeship or degree in logistics, supply chain management, international trade, or a comparable field.
• Experience: 2–5 years in import, export, or international logistics, with solid hands-on practice in customs and export handling.
• Independence: You're comfortable arriving without an existing department, a predecessor, or a finished playbook — and you see that as an advantage.
• Appetite for building: You don't just want to process shipments, you want to shape the function. You think about how something works at ten times the volume while you're doing it for the first time.
• Systems mindset: Confident with ERP systems, and inclined to build processes into the system rather than into isolated spreadsheets.
• Reliability: Commitments hold. When something slips, the team hears it early — not on the delivery date.
• Language: Fluent German, good English.
• Location: On-site in the greater Munich area.

What we're not looking for
• Administrators . If you're looking for a settled department with clear boundaries, this isn't it — that department doesn't exist yet, and building it is the job.
• People who want to lead without having done the operational work themselves. The first months are hands-on.
• Pragmatism without precision. Customs and export control don't forgive shortcuts.

What we offer
• Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West — in an environment where logistics isn't a support function but a precondition.
• Ownership of a function: From day one you own a function, not a task list. Your decisions stand.
• Growth path: The function grows with the company. Whoever builds it has the first claim on leading it.
• Short paths: Direct line to management, production, and engineering. "Special Forces" model — everyone ships, no politics, no bureaucracy.
• The environment: State-of-the-art manufacturing technology, a data-driven production environment, a site under construction.
• Compensation: Competitive salary incl. share options.
• Location: Factory ONE, greater Munich area.

Apply
• Resume: Show us what you've actually owned — not just where you've been.
• Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? And: what's the most complicated customs or export case you've personally resolved?

About Us

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Through our PPD® clinical research services, we support clinical trials in more than 100 countries, delivering laboratory, digital and decentralized solutions that help bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Our global Clinical Operations teams provide end-to-end clinical trial support — from study start-up through close-out — across commercial and government-sponsored studies.

Why Join Thermo Fisher Scientific / PPD?

- Work on high-quality, global clinical trials across diverse therapeutic areas

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to lead and coordinate all aspects of clinical monitoring and site management for complex clinical trials. Acting as a subject-matter expert and site process specialist, you will ensure trials are conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP, applicable regulatory requirements, and internal SOPs—ensuring subject safety, data integrity, and continuous audit readiness.

In this principal-level role, you will manage complex and high-risk studies across multiple sponsor and monitoring models (e.g. FSO, FSP, government-sponsored research). You will serve as a key escalation point for sites and project teams, take a leadership role on assigned studies, and actively contribute to the mentoring and development of junior and senior CRAs alike.

What You’ll Do

Principal-Level Clinical Monitoring & Oversight

- Lead monitoring activities for complex, high-risk, or strategically important clinical trials using a risk-based monitoring approach
- Independently conduct on-site and remote monitoring visits in line with approved monitoring plans
- Perform and oversee SDR, SDV, and CRF review, ensuring the highest standards of data accuracy and integrity
- Evaluate investigational product accountability through physical inventory and records review
- Ensure essential documents are complete, inspection-ready, and compliant with ICH-GCP and applicable German/EU regulations
- Lead site initiation, maintenance, and close-out activities, providing expert guidance and recommendations

Quality, Risk & Issue Management

- Apply advanced root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking, and problem-solving methodologies to identify systemic site issues
- Strategic Project & Stakeholder Collaboration
- Serve as a trusted partner to investigative sites, sponsors, and internal project teams
- Identify trends across sites and studies and provide strategic recommendations to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM)
- Ensure accurate and timely updates of study systems (e.g. CTMS) and perform QC reviews where required
- Participate in investigator meetings and support investigator identification and feasibility activities
- Support investigator payment processes and trial financial oversight as applicable

Leadership, Mentorship & Process Improvement

- Actively mentor, coach, and support the development of junior and senior CRAs
- Contribute to project-specific and functional training initiatives
- Identify opportunities for process optimization and drive implementation of improvements
- Provide expert input into monitoring strategies and clinical operations best practices

Administrative & Operational Responsibilities

- Maintain timely and accurate completion of timesheets, expense reports, and required documentation
- Maintain frequent communication with sites between visits to ensure ongoing compliance and issue resolution
- - Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to resolution and proactively mitigate risk
- Author high-quality monitoring reports and follow-up correspondence in a timely manner
- Act as a key escalation point for significant site issues, protocol deviations, and compliance risks
- Support and lead activities related to audits, inspections, and regulatory inquiries

- Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent qualification
- Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate / Monitor
- Valid driver’s license
- Full right to work in Germany
- Fluency in German and English (C1 level) – interviews will be conducted in German

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong clinical monitoring skills with hands-on RBM experience
- Excellent understanding and application of ICH-GCP and applicable regulations
- Solid therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
- Well-developed critical thinking, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with medical professionals
- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills
- Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to cross-functional teams
- Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic project environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn clinical systems (e.g., CTMS)

Locations: Home-based or hybrid anywhere in Germany
